notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Cayth.
Cayth does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one artifact creature token.
description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of an artifact creature token you control.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Cayth triggers, untapping Cayth.
Repeat.
